messages.embed_text:
Introduction

This document describes the architecture of the agentic RAG system. The system combines vector search, keyword search, and graph-based retrieval to provide high-quality answers grounded in a knowledge base.

messages.embed_text:
Retrieval Strategies

The retrieval engine supports five strategies: SEMANTIC (dense vector), KEYWORD (BM25 lexical), HYBRID (vector + keyword fused via RRF), GRAPH (graph traversal), and GRAPH_HYBRID (all three combined).

messages.embed_text:
Implementation Notes

All components are implemented in Rust using the tokio async runtime. Cross-encoder reranking via BGE-reranker-v2-m3 is applied after RRF fusion to improve result quality. Embeddings are generated locally using fastembed (ONNX).
